description: This file defines the PatientDAO interface, which declares database operations for managing Patient data and related entities such as allergies and identifiers within the OpenMRS medical record system.

classes.name: PatientDAO
classes.description: Interface defining database operations related to Patient management in OpenMRS.

methods.name: savePatient
methods.description: Saves a Patient object to the database, returning the persisted Patient.

methods.name: getPatient
methods.description: Retrieves a Patient by its ID.

methods.name: deletePatient
methods.description: Deletes a Patient from the database (primarily for testing or administration).

methods.name: getAllPatients
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all Patients, optionally including voided records.

methods.name: getPatients
methods.description: Searches for Patients based on query strings and other parameters, with support for pagination.

methods.name: getPatientIdentifiers
methods.description: Fetches patient identifiers matching specified criteria like identifier string, location, patients, and preference.

methods.name: savePatientIdentifierType
methods.description: Saves a new or updated PatientIdentifierType object.

methods.name: getAllPatientIdentifierTypes
methods.description: Retrieves all patient identifier types, including or excluding retired ones.

methods.name: getPatientIdentifierTypes
methods.description: Searches for PatientIdentifierTypes based on name, format, and other attributes.

methods.name: getPatientIdentifierType
methods.description: Retrieves a PatientIdentifierType by its ID.

methods.name: deletePatientIdentifierType
methods.description: Deletes a specified PatientIdentifierType.

methods.name: getDuplicatePatientsByAttributes
methods.description: Finds duplicate Patients based on a list of attribute criteria.

methods.name: isIdentifierInUseByAnotherPatient
methods.description: Checks if a given PatientIdentifier is assigned to another Patient.

methods.name: getPatientByUuid
methods.description: Fetches a Patient by its UUID.

methods.name: getPatientIdentifierByUuid
methods.description: Fetches a PatientIdentifier by its UUID.

methods.name: getPatientIdentifierTypeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a PatientIdentifierType matching the provided UUID.

methods.name: getPatientIdentifier
methods.description: Retrieves a PatientIdentifier by its ID.

methods.name: savePatientIdentifier
methods.description: Saves a PatientIdentifier object.

methods.name: deletePatientIdentifier
methods.description: Deletes a PatientIdentifier.

methods.name: getCountOfPatients
methods.description: Counts the number of Patients matching a specific query, considering voided status.
